title: FundamentalFact
description: obs.fundamental_fact r1: one filed value of one concept of one issuer, as a filing reported it; append only.

source.description: Where the fact came from; a later source extends the enum additively.

subject.description: The issuer text of the watch list: cik:<10 digits>, or edinet:<code>.

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy of the concept, for example us-gaap, dei or sec.

unit.description: Unit of the value, for example USD, shares, JPY or sic.

currency.description: Currency code of a money value; empty when the unit is not money.

period_start.description: First day of the period of a duration fact; null for an instant fact. The key is always present.

period_end.description: Last day of the period, or the day of an instant fact.

form.description: Form of the filing, for example 10-K.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the filing document: the accession number or the EDINET document id.

retrieved_at.description: Instant the fact was retrieved, UTC.

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw source document, lower-case hex.
